about: After Sign-Off Facebook Reels schedule. Times are Philippine time (+08:00). Edit freely; run `npm run check` after editing.

episodes.story: Do Not Look at the Moon

facebook.caption:
If you hear this alert, do not look at the moon

If this alert ever comes on your TV, close your curtains. Now.

Watch the street in the first five seconds. Then watch the clock. 👁️

Broadcast 01 · After Sign-Off. Original fiction.
#analoghorror #emergencyalert #horror #scary #creepy #reels

He hijacked two TV channels in one night. No one knows who.

November 22, 1987. Chicago. A man in a rubber mask cut into two TV broadcasts in one night. He was never identified.

Check the VCR. Then check the coffee table. 📺

Broadcast 02 · After Sign-Off. True story (the 1987 Chicago signal intrusions), recreated in low-poly 3D. No real broadcast footage or audio is used.
#analoghorror #unsolved #truestory #maxheadroom #80s #reels

Footprints led to the house. None led away.

Bavaria, 1922. Tracks in the snow led from the forest to a lonely farm. None led away. Then the farmer heard footsteps in the attic.

Watch the attic window in the very first second. 🕯️

Broadcast 03 · After Sign-Off. True story (the unsolved Hinterkaifeck case), recreated in low-poly 3D. Nothing violent is shown.
#unsolved #unsolvedmysteries #truestory #analoghorror #history #reels

Rules for the night shift at a mountain weather station

Kestrel Ridge Weather Station. You're alone up here until morning. Follow the rules.

Did you read rule 7 before it was read to you? 📋

Broadcast 04 · After Sign-Off. Original fiction.
#analoghorror #rulehorror #nightshift #horror #creepy #reels

Nine hikers cut their tent open from the inside

February 1959, the northern Urals. Nine experienced hikers cut their tent open from the inside and walked into the snow in their socks.

Count the lines of footprints. 👣

Broadcast 05 · After Sign-Off. True story (the Dyatlov Pass incident), recreated in low-poly 3D. Nothing violent is shown.
#dyatlovpass #unsolvedmysteries #truestory #analoghorror #history #reels

Our sonar picked up our own submarine. Behind us.

300 metres down, the contact behind us had our exact sound. Same propeller. Same rattle.

Watch the wide shot before the reveal. Who's standing next to him? 👀

Broadcast 06 · After Sign-Off. Original fiction.
#analoghorror #submarine #horror #scary #creepy #reels

episodes.story: This Is the Voice of Vrillon

facebook.caption:
In 1977, a voice took over the evening news

26 November 1977, southern England. During the early evening news, the sound on one transmitter was replaced for about six minutes by a calm, distorted voice that said it was not from Earth. The picture never changed. The station apologised; the authorities called it a hoax. No one was ever identified.

Watch the clock. Then watch the child. 👀

Broadcast 07 · After Sign-Off. True story (the Southern Television broadcast interruption), recreated in low-poly 3D. No original broadcast audio is used.
#analoghorror #unsolved #truestory #broadcastintrusion #horror #reels

My thermal camera found a warm room that isn't on the plans

Empty house. No power, no heating. One wall upstairs reads 37 °C on my thermal camera. On the plans there's nothing behind it.

Watch the carpet in the thermal shots. Then count the windows. 👀

Broadcast 08 · After Sign-Off. Original fiction.
#analoghorror #thermalcamera #horror #scary #creepy #reels

Three lighthouse keepers vanished. One left his coat.

December 1900. A lighthouse in the Flannan Isles, off the west of Scotland, went dark. Storms kept the relief boat away for eleven days. When it landed, all three keepers were gone. One set of oilskins was still on its hook.

Look at the kitchen. Then look down the path in the last shot. 🕯️

Broadcast 09 · After Sign-Off. True story (the Flannan Isles lighthouse), recreated in low-poly 3D. Nothing violent is shown.
#unsolvedmysteries #lighthouse #truestory #analoghorror #scotland #reels

episodes.story: The Night the Lake Breathed Out

facebook.caption:
In one night, this lake breathed out

21 August 1986, Cameroon. Late at night, Lake Nyos released a huge cloud of carbon dioxide. Heavier than air, it flowed down the valleys below. 1,746 people died that night. Today, pipes draw the gas up from the bottom of the lake.

Watch the lamp in the window. Then listen. 🌫️

Broadcast 10 · After Sign-Off. True story (the Lake Nyos disaster), recreated in low-poly 3D. No people are shown.
#lakenyos #truestory #science #analoghorror #cameroon #reels

Huwag kang titingin sa salamin sa Balete Drive

Balete Drive, New Manila, Quezon City. Mula pa noong dekada singkwenta, iisa ang kuwento ng mga taxi driver: isang babaeng nakaputi sa tabi ng puno ng balete, pumapara. Hindi mahalaga kung huminto ka o hindi.

Tingnan mo ang upuan sa likod sa unang segundo. 👻

Broadcast 11 · After Sign-Off. Kilalang urban legend sa Pilipinas, ginawa sa low-poly 3D. Walang totoong biktimang natukoy kailanman.
#BaleteDrive #WhiteLady #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #urbanlegend #reels

Pag humihina ang tunog… lumalapit siya

Sabi ng matatanda: kapag malakas ang "tik-tik," malayo pa. Kapag mahina na… nasa bubong mo na. Isang gabi ng pista, nagbuhos si Lola ng asin sa bintana. Kinaumagahan, nakakalat ang asin. Mula sa loob.

Gamitin ang headphones. 🎧 Pakinggan kung saan galing ang huling "tik."

Broadcast 12 · After Sign-Off. Original na kuwento (fiction), batay sa paniniwala tungkol sa tiktik.
#tiktik #aswang #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #pinoyfolklore #reels

Kapag may nakita kang kalahating babae… hanapin mo ang asin

Sa Visayas, sabi nila, may mga babaeng dalawa ang buhay. Sa araw, kapitbahay. Sa gabi, iniiwan niya ang kalahati ng sarili niya. Kapag nakita mo ang kalahating iyon… alam mo na ang gagawin.

Tingnan mo ang palda ng kapitbahay. 👀

Broadcast 13 · After Sign-Off. Kuwentong-bayan (folklore) ng manananggal, ginawa sa low-poly 3D.
#manananggal #aswang #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #pinoyfolklore #reels

Sa Baguio, may hotel na kumakain pa rin ang mga bisita

Dominican Hill, Baguio. Ang lumang Diplomat Hotel: itinayo ng mga Dominikano, pinagtaguan noong giyera, naging hotel, at iniwan sa hamog. Sabi ng mga tagapagbantay, pagkalipas ng hatinggabi, may kumakatok. Tapos, tunog ng mga plato.

Bilangin mo ang mga upuan bago at pagkatapos mamatay ang flashlight. 🕯️

Broadcast 14 · After Sign-Off. Kilalang kuwento ng multo, ginawa sa low-poly 3D. Walang tala ang mga historyador na nangyari ang mga pugot na kuwento. Heritage site ito; igalang ang lugar.
#DiplomatHotel #Baguio #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #ghoststory #reels

Kapag may umiiyak na sanggol sa damuhan… huwag kang hihinto

Huling biyahe. Madilim na daan sa probinsya. May umiiyak na sanggol sa damuhan, nakabalot sa lampin. Siyempre, huminto ang driver. Magaan pa sa una…

Panoorin ulit ang windshield sa dulo. 👶

Broadcast 15 · After Sign-Off. Kuwentong-bayan (folklore) ng tiyanak, ginawa sa low-poly 3D. Kathang-isip ang driver at ang jeep.
#tiyanak #aswang #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #pinoyfolklore #reels

Huwag mong aalisin ang tingin mo sa nurse sa Ward 3

Clark, Pampanga. Nang magsara ang base, naiwan ang ospital. Sabi ng mga bumibisita: mga boses, mga bato mula sa dilim, at isang nurse na nakaputi sa pagitan ng mga kama. Huwag mong aalisin ang tingin mo sa kanya.

Bilangin mo ang mga bato. 👀

Broadcast 16 · After Sign-Off. Kilalang kuwento ng multo, ginawa sa low-poly 3D. Mga ulat at alamat lamang ang mga kababalaghan. Huwag pumasok nang walang pahintulot.
#Clark #Pampanga #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #ghoststory #reels

Kapag tatlong beses mo nang nadaanan ang parehong tindahan… huminto ka

Gabi. Isang tricycle. Isang daang napapalibutan ng kawayan. Nadaanan niya ang tindahan ni Aling Nena. Tapos, nadaanan niya ulit. At ulit. Sabi ng mga lola, kapag ganito… huminto ka at baligtarin mo ang damit mo.

Tingnan mo ang presyuhan sa bawat daan. 👀

Broadcast 17 · After Sign-Off. Kuwentong-bayan (folklore) ng tikbalang, ginawa sa low-poly 3D. Kathang-isip ang tindahan at ang rider.
#tikbalang #tabitabipo #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #pinoyfolklore #reels

episodes.story: The Light in the Quezon Room

facebook.caption:
Gabi-gabi, may ilaw sa Malacañang na kusang bumubukas

Malacañang. Sa loob ng maraming henerasyon, iisa ang kuwento ng mga nagtatrabaho roon: isang ilaw na kusang bumubukas, mga yabag sa itaas, usok sa kuwartong walang tao, tawa ng bata sa pasilyo.

Tingnan mo ang upuan sa opisina. Dalawang beses. 🕯️

Broadcast 18 · After Sign-Off. Mga kuwento at alaala ng mga nagtrabaho sa palasyo, iniulat sa mga pahayagan, ginawa sa low-poly 3D. Walang taong pinangalanan.
#Malacanang #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #ghoststory #urbanlegend #reels

Kapag may liwanag na sumusunod sa'yo sa palayan… huwag mo itong sundan

Gabi. Palayan. Isang bola ng apoy na sumasabay sa bawat hakbang mo. Kapag huminto ka, humihinto rin ito. Sabi ng matatanda, kaluluwa raw ito ng nalunod… at dinadala ka nito sa tubig.

Panoorin ang kanal sa unang malawak na kuha. 👀

Broadcast 19 · After Sign-Off. Kuwentong-bayan (folklore) ng santelmo, at ang totoong St. Elmo's fire, ginawa sa low-poly 3D.
#santelmo #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #pinoyfolklore #stelmosfire #reels

Sa teatrong ito, laging may nakaupo sa mga bakanteng upuan

Manila Film Center. Noong Nobyembre 17, 1981, bandang alas tres ng madaling-araw, bumagsak ang scaffolding at nahulog ang mga trabahador sa basang semento. Hanggang ngayon, hindi malinaw kung ilan ang namatay. Mula noon, iisa ang kuwento ng mga guwardiya at performer: puno raw ang mga upuan pagpatay ng ilaw.

Panoorin ang unang segundo. Bilangin ang mga upuang nakababa. 🕯️

Broadcast 20 · After Sign-Off. Season finale. Totoong aksidente; alamat lamang ang mga multo. Inaalala namin ang mga trabahador at ang kanilang mga pamilya.
#ManilaFilmCenter #kwentongkatatakutan #pinoyhorror #ghoststory #urbanlegend #reels
